inputs.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
inputs.why: The Google Cloud project to deploy into. It must already exist with billing enabled; the deployment enables the APIs it needs but can't create a project or attach billing.

inputs.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_REGION
inputs.why: Where Cloud Run runs the verifier and the sample API. Defaulted, so a first try doesn't need it.

inputs.name: DNSID_TRUSTED_GOVERNANCE
inputs.why: The governance IDs the edge trusts, comma-separated. Defaulted to the sandbox governance that Partner Preview Portal agents use; set it to trust your own organization's agents.
